description: Defines the DataGroup class in the OrangeHRM installer utility, representing a data grouping with permissions and allowed settings, including factory and accessor methods.

classes.name: DataGroup
classes.description: Represents a data group entity with name, description, allowed permission, and a list of permissions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a DataGroup object with name, description, allowed permission, and permissions.

methods.name: createFromArray
methods.description: Creates a DataGroup instance from a name and an array containing its data, including permissions.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the data group.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of the data group.

methods.name: getAllowed
methods.description: Returns the AllowedPermission object associated with the data group.

methods.name: getPermissions
methods.description: Returns the array of DataGroupPermission objects associated with the data group.
